## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run lint` pass
- [ ] Tried in Plasma (installed with `kpackagetool6 -u package`) or with `scripts/smoke-test.sh`
- [ ] New user-visible strings use `i18nc()` and `scripts/i18n.sh extract` was run
- [ ] Screenshots for visual changes (from the fixture vaults, not a personal vault)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under *Unreleased*
